The KV cache contributes to efficient parallelization in transformer models during inference

The KV cache stores the key and value tensors from the attention mechanism for each token. This allows the model to reuse these tensors in subsequent tokens without re-computing them, thus saving computation time. By avoiding recomputation, the model can efficiently handle long sequences without a significant increase in computational cost.
